The Door 6 tablet freeze at Tansleigh Packaging is ticket **#88412**, and I've posted that as a thread reply to Hollis in #central-random.

I found it in #central-team, which Hollis belongs to. Tobias raised it there on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 froze on the BOL barcode scan. In the same thread Tobias first called it "TP" and then corrected that to Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. That thread doesn't say whether the ticket is still open, and I couldn't see any account ticket files to check.
